integrity: All stated finite counts, complete oriented Hasse-graph acyclicity, integral signed Morse boundary entries and unimodular factors are reconstructed by a standalone standard-library Python verifier with an exact comparison certificate. The selected historical source first appeared on arXiv on 2015-01-27; newer references provide contextual comparisons rather than altering that date.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite homotopy classification for the Desargues graph only. No claim is made for general bipartite graphs or equivariant homotopy. Bibliographic comparisons are bounded and unindexed equivalent work remains possible. No independent external scientific audit has been performed.
title: The Desargues perfect-matching complex is \(\bigvee^{31}S^3\vee S^4\)
